summary: Submitted a check with a new consensus-safety obligation and a real in-memory Raft harness. Source finding: verifyLeader sizes the quorum from Voter entries but registers every replication stream, and a successful heartbeat to a configured Nonvoter calls notifyAll(true), which increments the same VerifyLeader vote counter; a leader can therefore report confirmed with no successful voter confirmation beyond itself. The harness reduces a four-node cluster to three voters plus one non-voter, partitions the two non-leader voters, and locally measured result=confirmed, voter_quorum_met=false, voter_confirmation_count=0, nonvoter_confirmation_count=1. Controller read-only preflight is valid. Formal retained execution and human review remain required; the harness declines the optional pipeline fast path only so every AppendEntries confirmation is observable.
